preexisting_diagnostics.message: `:=` from `get_node()` / `get_node_or_null()` compiles, but infers the bare type `Node`, so every later member access on the variable is unchecked and only fails at runtime. In a project that raises `unsafe_property_access` / `unsafe_method_access` it becomes a parse error as well.
preexisting_diagnostics.suggested_fix: Annotate with the node's real class: `var timer: Timer = get_node("Timer")`. See references/gdscript_conventions.md.
